blind.B1: Yes, exploratory. Data descriptor with a real exercise arm: CONT SCI + SWIM (5) and CONT SCI + SWW (5) vs sedentary CONT SCI tiny cage (4) in the SCI+Exercise set (S1.p3, S2.2.p1, S2.2.p4); also an in-cage activity contrast (Large vs Tiny cage, 5 vs 5; S2.2.p3). No/TX arms are injury controls, not exercise.
blind.B2: No DE comparisons reported. Intended: SWIM (n=5) vs CONT (n=4), SWW (n=5) vs CONT (n=4) in the Exercise set (22 rats); CONT Large (5) vs CONT Tiny (5) in the Activity set (15 rats; No SCI std 5) (S2.2.p1). Injury contrasts (CONT vs No SCI, TX vs CONT) are not exercise.
blind.B3: None: one liver per rat, 37 rats, 37 samples (S2.2.p1, S2.3.p1). Rats doubly housed by group (cage partners), no cage ID in metadata; candidate pairing keys in packet A link only 8/37 and are replicate numbers, not animals.
blind.B4: Paper does not say (it reports no DE test, only DESeq2 RLE normalization, S2.5.p3, S8.p9).
blind.B5: Paper states no DEG rule and reports no DEG counts (S2.5, S4.3).

checks.evidence: Run as exploratory is right: exercise arms exist (S1.p3, S2.2.p1); labelled exploratory since descriptor has no DE test.

Packet B levels: SWIM 5, SWW 5, CT 9 = 4 (Ex) + 5 (Ac), CL 5; n matches S2.2.p1; sets kept separate via cell=set x arm (exercise_set 22, activity_set 15); control is the sedentary CONT tiny-cage animals of the same set; no exclusions.
Contrasts control=CT, treatment=SWIM/SWW/CL, i.e. exercise (or large cage) vs sedentary control.
No repeated measures; one liver per rat. Cage partners not identifiable; recorded as caveat.
Paper silent (B4); one joint cell-means model per set, recorded as design choice. Open policy item only.
Cage housing and the 13.5 wk vs 11.5 wk time (S2.3.p1, S4.4.p1) vs GEO 11.5 wk are recorded as caveat and discrepancy; sets kept separate for depth/housing differences.
HTSeq integer counts, file named RawCounts, S8.p7; DESeq2 consistent with S8.p9.
Paper states no rule; padj<0.05, no FC cutoff, threshold_source=workflow_default recorded (S2.5, S4.3).
Paper reports no DEG counts; HANDBACK lists 'not reported' and claims no match.

human_items: Open policy: joint per-set fit vs pairwise fits when the paper is silent.
Paper says exercised animals collected at 13.5 wk but GEO says 11.5 wk; exercise may be inseparable from time (already recorded as a caveat).
summary: 这是一篇数据描述论文，没有差异表达检验、阈值或DEG数量。分析把运动臂（SWIM、SWW）与同一批次的久坐CONT对照、以及大笼与小笼活动对比作为探索性分析，样本数、方向、模型和阈值记录均与论文一致。未发现阻断或主要问题。
